name: Label Reader
description: Snap a food label and your AI explains the ingredients, allergens, additives and sugar.
prompt: Take a photo of a food ingredients label with the camera and Acornix.askAI with the image explains the ingredients in plain words, highlights allergens, additives and sugar, and gives a simple health score, with a history.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Haz una foto a una etiqueta de comida y tu IA te explica los ingredientes, alérgenos, aditivos y azúcar.
